files.README.md:
# Maple & Lath - outbound freight register

One row per shipment. freight_quote is the carrier's estimate captured
at booking. freight_cost is the invoiced amount after weigh-in and the
fuel surcharge - the amount Maple & Lath actually pays.
files.notes/carrier_contacts.txt:
Ravenwood's dispatch window closes mid afternoon; late pallets roll to the
next day. Bluegrange wants pallet dimensions at booking. Cardinal bills a
residential surcharge on the invoice that never shows in the booking
estimate. Billing questions go to the freight desk.

turns.prompt: Maple & Lath is reconciling outbound freight against the carrier invoices. The freight register is at shipping/freight_register.csv. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. How much did the shop actually pay in freight for shipments to Ohio in September 2026?
